background: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Wells Fargo, one of the four largest US banks, with the largest branch network in the country, serving consumers, small businesses and corporates across the United States.
synthesis: The bank is rated AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 7 Feb 2018. Capital is mixed against US banks: CET1 of 12.1% is just below the peer median and has fallen 1.2 points since 30 Jun 2025, while leverage of 8.0% is in the top quarter. Liquidity is sound, with LCR of 119% above the median. The newest flagged item, on 17 Sep 2026, is continuing layoffs, alongside strong second-quarter profit; neither is a credit concern.
